INSERT_AFTER: <DonorType> -> regex of the one donor line after which the recipe inserts the block carried in the fourth column (segments separated by a literal \n; an empty first segment is a blank line), verified by body_match like the anchor. DROP_METHOD: <DonorType>.<method> whose whole declaration (annotations to closing brace, one trailing blank line) the recipe removes -> reason (here one stale donor oracle method). Not ported; the module's catalog row union-find keeps naming IntUnionFind.union as the donor entry point (families-20261106 owns the catalog); whether a monitor-observing facade over M3IntDisjointSet is wanted is a human decision
